name: Smart AI Chatbot for Your Website by Breev
author: Tom Kuhn

sections.description:
Breev is a powerful, modern AI chatbot for websites that works with large language models (LLMs). It allows your visitors to interact in natural language — without any complex setup. While optimized for German, Breev also supports multiple languages such as English and more.

Ideal for businesses and websites that want to offer automated support or a dynamic, conversational user experience — directly on their own WordPress site.

Key Features:

  • AI chatbot optimized for natural language
  • Multi-language support (e.g., German, English, more)
  • Easy integration via CDN or WordPress plugin
  • GDPR-friendly (no data sharing with third parties)
  • Customizable design for seamless integration

External services

This plugin connects to the Breev external service to provide chatbot functionality.
Only chat messages are transmitted to Breev’s servers to generate meaningful responses.
No personal data such as IP address, name, or location is collected or stored.

More information:

  • https://breev.ai/terms (Legal Notice)
  • https://breev.ai/privacy (Privacy Policy)
sections.installation:
To install and activate the Breev Chatbot plugin on your WordPress site:

  1. Install the plugin via the WordPress plugin dashboard or upload the ZIP file manually.
  2. Visit https://breev.ai, create a free account, and start the demo.
  3. Add your content sources in the Breev dashboard under “Chatbot.”
  4. Customize the chatbot’s design and choose your color scheme.
  5. Copy the generated Chatbot ID and color settings.
  6. In your WordPress admin panel, go to Settings → Chatbot and paste in your Chatbot ID and color codes.
  7. The chatbot will now automatically appear on your website.
  8. You can view all user conversations in your Breev dashboard.
sections.faq:
Is the chatbot optimized for German only?

No. While Breev is highly optimized for German, it also supports English and other languages.

Can I customize the chatbot’s appearance and behavior?

Yes. You can change the color, position, and behavior to fit your website. Additional configuration options are available on the Breev platform.

How do I embed the chatbot on my website?

You can use the provided CDN snippet or this plugin. Setup takes just a few minutes.

Is the chatbot GDPR-compliant?

Yes. No personal data is stored or shared. Optional self-hosting is also available for full data control.
